plan.notes: Term-by-term sequence transcribed verbatim from the official Grossmont College Counseling 'Orthopedic Technology, Associate of Science Pathway' advising sheet (2025-2026, rev. 5/2025): Semester I Fall: OT 110 (5), OT 111 (4), OT 112 (3); Semester II Spring: OT 210 (5), OT 211 (4), OT 212 (3); Semester III Summer: OT 214 (4), OT 215 (3). Sheet sequence sums to 31 = catalog 'Total Units 31'. Course titles/units cross-checked against the official catalog page (2026-2027 listing, identical 8 courses/31 units): https://catalog.gcccd.edu/grossmont/associate-degree-programs-certificates/health-sciences/orthopedic-technology-as-cert-achievement/ Professional-phase program: admission requires Human Anatomy BIO 140 or Anatomy & Physiology I BIO 144 (grade C or higher, within 10 years, completed before program entry); GE is strongly recommended before admission but is not part of the published pathway, so GE courses are not sequenced here. Per-slot prerequisites are not published on the advising sheet; the published semester order is the authoritative progression, so prereq arrays are intentionally empty. Certificate of Achievement: the official sheet states any student completing only the major courses above qualifies for the Certificate of Achievement in Orthopedic Technology (same 3-semester pathway as the AS).
